name: My Taxi Dad
description: The film centres on a taxi driver who picks up a taciturn young girl with unsettling behaviour. What begins as a chance ride soon draws the driver and the mysterious stranger into a chain of events shrouded in doubt and suspicion, prompting audiences to reflect deeply on human nature, trust, and looming danger. Departing from conventional sentimental storytelling, the film adopts a suspense-driven narrative filled with twists. When the “suspect” gripping the steering wheel encounters a silent “enigma”, an accidental encounter becomes the light that pierces the darkest moments of their lives.
original_title: Wo de di shi ba ba
